newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lihir sees first gold pour in May.
newsitem.headline: Lihir sees first gold pour in May.

text.p: Lihir Gold Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to start the processing of oxide ore next week, with the first gold pour later in May.
Lihir chairman Ross Garnaut told the annual meeting that the project is scheduled to start processing sulphide ore by October 1997.

Garnaut said Lihir has protected much of its 1997 revenue by the forward sale of 150,000 ounces of gold at a price of A$406.35 per ounce. Lihir is expected to produce about 175,000 ounces of gold in 1997.
Lihir plans to produce more than 550,000 ounces in 1998 and then about 600,000 ounces a year for 15 years.
Lihir is owned 22.9 percent by Southern Gold, which is itself owned 75 percent by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd and 25 percent by Vengold Inc.
Niugini Mining Ltd owns 17.15 percent and the PNG government and landowners 17.5 percent.
